content.value: A railway station has only one loading bay manned by a maximum of three - person crew. Studies identified that average arrival rate of trains for unloading is 4/hour and average service . rate is 6 train/ hour. Explain the appropriateness of the number of crew in the system. The train waiting charges are BDT 20 per hour and the loading crew costs BDT 6 per hour. It can be assumed that work capacity is proportional to the number of crews.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
